summary: The regression is reproduced twice, so the remaining way it could be wrong is causal: perhaps the instrumented store's held-open write loses the term by itself and the off-thread heartbeat merely happens to be present in both runs. That is the competing explanation a control can settle, and it is cheap because the scenario is already built. This turn queues the control: the same single node, the same instrumented store, the same depose and the same held-open election write, with one thing missing - the empty heartbeat delivered on the fast path during the hold. If the term after release is still higher than the term that was held, 3 to 4, then the held write is monotone on its own and the regression in the two witness runs is attributable to the off-thread write; if the term fell without that heartbeat, the regression belongs to the instrumentation and I would withdraw the witness account rather than keep it. I recorded the refined discriminator on the same investigation rather than opening a new one, since it is the same cause and the same responsibility, and I cited the two saved premises it relies on by exact ID and revision, the unguarded read-modify-write behaviour and the reproduced regression fact at revision two. No interpretation is recorded until the control's receipt exists. The harness validates and the control is queued for clean-copy execution; the six witnessed findings from earlier turns remain recorded and unaffected.
